meta.title: About us
meta.description: {brand} is an Egyptian software startup based in Maadi, Cairo, building accurate, simple systems for companies in Egypt and the Gulf, including the Albiruni platform.

hero.title: An Egyptian startup, with services reaching from Egypt to the Gulf.
hero.description: {brand} is an Egyptian software startup founded in April 2025 and based in Maadi, Cairo. We design solutions, apps and systems and roll them out inside companies across Egypt and the Gulf, staying with our clients from the first idea to full operation.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.title: Accurate, simple systems that sales reps use in the field and managers use in the office, without the complexity.
mission.text: We understand your processes first, then build solutions that stay with you from setup to full operation.

vision.label: Our vision
vision.title: To be a trusted tech partner for growing companies in Egypt and the Gulf, and to make Albiruni a daily tool that managers and reps rely on.
vision.text: One platform that brings field work and management together in a simple, direct way.

albiruni.title: One system for all of your company's work, from the field to the office.
albiruni.subtitle: Albiruni brings sales, collections, inventory and invoicing into one platform, and grows with your company step by step.

allInOne.title: Every service in one platform
allInOne.text: Sales, collections, inventory, invoicing and reports in one system instead of scattered tools.

scalable.title: Scales with your company
scalable.text: Start with what you need today, then add users, branches and add-ons as you grow.

sectors.title: Built for your sector
sectors.text: Ready-made setups for distribution, field sales and car service centers.

fieldApp.title: An app for reps, a dashboard for managers
fieldApp.text: Reps log orders and visits from their phone while managers follow everything live.

cashSettlement.title: Fast, instant cash settlement for reps
cashSettlement.text: A clear daily close for cash and collections, with no paperwork or long reviews.

eInvoicing.title: E-invoicing ready
eInvoicing.text: Issue e-invoices straight from the system, with no extra software.

clarity.title: Clarity first
clarity.text: We agree on scope, cost and timelines before we start, and we stick to them.

ownership.title: We own the product
ownership.text: We build Albiruni ourselves, so we own its quality and long-term support.

closeness.title: Close to our clients
closeness.text: A team that answers you directly and understands how your local market works.

improvement.title: Better every month
improvement.text: Regular updates driven by real feedback from the people who use it.
